programme.desc: Allosaurus and Salt: Andy Day travels back in time after promising to get some more salt for Hatty so she can finish her display of a fossilised footprint of an allosaurus. S1 E20

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Cafe: In the park Bluey meets a new playmate Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends. S2 E34

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Couch Potato: Evil Pea tries to trap Supertato down the back of a sofa but falls in too. Luckily, they meet Raisin, who lives there with her buttons and knows the only way out. S2 E34

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Stick Badge: Duggee and the squirrels prepare for a campfire by collecting sticks of all sizes. S2 E31

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: Z: Dee encourages a friend to say 'z', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see some zips, do some zooming and see some zebras crossing a road! S7 E26

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Scooter Stand Still: Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back. S2 E26

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Dead Wood: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how dead wood plays an important role in the environment. S1 E3

programme.title: Dog Loves Books

programme.title: Andy's Wild Adventures
programme.desc: Cheetahs: Andy and Kip are in Africa in search of the fastest land mammal in the world, the cheetah. S1 E40

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Hey Duggee: Songs
programme.desc: Building Song: We're building buildings with Chew Chew and the squirrels, sing along. S1 E20

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Escape: When Mum and Dad describe a made-up world where they can relax without the girls, Bluey and Bingo decide to burst into their fantasy and chase them down. How will Mum and Dad escape? S2 E21

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Sofa: Stanley has to fix Myrtles wobbly sofa so her and her friends can watch Fred and Fifi on the Boogie Woogie Dance Show together. He ends up creating a super-duper special sofa. S1 E16

programme.title: Dinopaws
programme.desc: The Thing We Scared: When a scary Scarypaw frightens a Critter, the Dinopaws find that kindness solves all. S1 E44

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
programme.desc: Andy and the Hawksbill Turtles: Andy goes on an adventure to find Hawksbill Turtles. S1 E15

programme.title: Kit & Pup
programme.desc: Soil: Kit and Pup are gardening. The soil is too hard to dig, so Kit and Pup need to come up with a solution. S1 E48

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: Bluey
